scope.equilibrium_reporting: Strict counts are taken from the accepted-entry ladder. Weak counts are included only when a cited journal line names the body and states the counts; otherwise they are unknown.
scope.coverage_note: The inspected journal has unread archive spans on 11, 13, and 14 September 2026. Additional accepted bodies may be absent; the 136 rows are not a complete census.
scope.replay_note: This dated record is not a claim that all listed bodies were independently rerun while preparing this catalog. A package link means that a matching public package path was recorded and its target exists.

ordering_and_parentage.ordering: Entries are sorted by their recorded UTC timestamps; chronology alone does not establish a parent-child relation.
ordering_and_parentage.parent_field: The documented parent is a named body or route stage when supported. Assignment identifiers are omitted. A null value means no body parent is stated in the selected record.
